fa09ee7e-d20a-45d4-81e3-cf4a930ab7b3.name: integrations
fa09ee7e-d20a-45d4-81e3-cf4a930ab7b3.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Registry of configured integrations per tenant. One row per (tenant, external system, direction). Used by both inbound and outbound flows to look up protocol, auth method, mappings, and rate limits. Mirrors the integration registry described in HLD-05 section 7.1.

8be30346-f071-411b-8829-e190670fe103.name: integration_credentials
8be30346-f071-411b-8829-e190670fe103.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Per-integration credential references. Stores the *path* into the platform's secret store (e.g., Azure Key Vault) rather than raw credential bytes. The Integration Hub fetches the actual credential at runtime via the configured secret-store client. Per HLD-05 section 7.3 (no credentials in cleartext anywhere except the vault).

d3fe9ee7-eb4d-43e4-8a6b-be486f81558a.name: integration_workflows
d3fe9ee7-eb4d-43e4-8a6b-be486f81558a.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. FSM instance per workflow run. One row per workflow execution (e.g., one ABDM M1 enrollment attempt, one M3 data-exchange session). The FSM engine reads/writes this table to advance state. Per ADR-0027.

7f1bf40a-4d6d-4925-b2cf-7bea1858c2f7.name: integration_workflow_transitions
7f1bf40a-4d6d-4925-b2cf-7bea1858c2f7.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Append-only log of every FSM state transition. Provides regulatory audit (what state, when, triggered by what). Per ADR-0027. Never UPDATE.

e5b4d40e-1935-49eb-8b3b-4bf93be653a2.name: integration_workflow_timers
e5b4d40e-1935-49eb-8b3b-4bf93be653a2.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Pending wall-clock timers. The timer worker polls due rows with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and fires the corresponding transition. Per ADR-0027.

88837e4a-f195-487d-8532-9cdff76e5f61.name: integration_inbound_messages
88837e4a-f195-487d-8532-9cdff76e5f61.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Receipt log for inbound messages (HL7v2 from analyzers, FHIR R4 from external HIPs, gateway callbacks). Provides idempotency (same external_message_id => same outcome) and correlation to workflow instances.

ff39d942-5c73-456a-a8af-9959cad43829.name: integration_outbound_messages
ff39d942-5c73-456a-a8af-9959cad43829.comment: Citus: DISTRIBUTED by iq_tenant_id. Submission log for outbound messages. Tracks retry state, circuit-breaker counts, and the response from the external system. Idempotency keys are message-level, not request-level.

f0f3a4c0-79a9-42bb-a9bd-10e7eacda967.name: iq_tenant_id
f0f3a4c0-79a9-42bb-a9bd-10e7eacda967.comment: Distribution column. The tenant that owns this integration.

a69bcc2f-cb8f-464f-93d5-d3fe7fe88ad9.name: kind
a69bcc2f-cb8f-464f-93d5-d3fe7fe88ad9.comment: Integration category. Drives which adapter handles this integration. | CHECK: kind IN ('abdm','lab_analyzer','legacy_his','tpa','government_reporting','ris_pacs','custom')

be26ce0d-fc6d-434c-b7a1-f7b8065a0338.name: auth_method
be26ce0d-fc6d-434c-b7a1-f7b8065a0338.comment: How this integration authenticates. 'none' is reserved for development; production must use one of the other three. | CHECK: auth_method IN ('api_key','mtls','oauth2_client_credentials','none')

a95b17e9-5044-4ce1-82dd-171f0d2a4f6d.name: rate_limit_rpm
a95b17e9-5044-4ce1-82dd-171f0d2a4f6d.comment: Per-tenant rate limit in requests per minute. NULL = no limit.

f7f7e277-8179-4f96-bf00-b87e14d26631.name: config
f7f7e277-8179-4f96-bf00-b87e14d26631.comment: Integration-specific configuration. For ABDM: {clientIdRef, clientSecretRef (vault paths), gatewayBaseUrl, hfrFacilityIdRef (Configurator path), cmId, environment}. For HL7v2: {endpointUrl, vendorProfile, mappingProfileId}.

efabdd57-ad6b-40a9-a72d-6fcdbc2e9546.name: registered_by
efabdd57-ad6b-40a9-a72d-6fcdbc2e9546.comment: User Management user_id who registered this integration.

211f5262-6588-4d06-8fee-8fb0107ef772.name: integration_id
211f5262-6588-4d06-8fee-8fb0107ef772.comment: FK-equivalent to integrations.id (no actual FK because Citus distributed).

28252548-de26-4c70-8689-6f139bb54f99.name: vault_ref
28252548-de26-4c70-8689-6f139bb54f99.comment: Opaque reference understood by the platform's secret-store adapter (e.g., 'azure-keyvault://hims/abdm/sandbox/clientSecret').

78720371-ad73-438d-941b-1b8afd30a0f6.name: expires_at
78720371-ad73-438d-941b-1b8afd30a0f6.comment: Set when the upstream credential has a known expiry (e.g., short-lived gateway access tokens). NULL for static credentials.

525986ae-7430-4878-896b-575809cc565a.name: id
525986ae-7430-4878-896b-575809cc565a.comment: Workflow instance ID. Used as correlation_id in audit log.

8b6ce171-f366-40fb-8535-f395ca09e4e1.name: definition_id
8b6ce171-f366-40fb-8535-f395ca09e4e1.comment: FSM definition identifier, e.g., 'abdm.m1.enrollment.v1', 'abdm.m2.linking.v1', 'abdm.m3.hip.v1', 'abdm.m3.hiu.v1'. Pinned per-workflow so a definition update does not retroactively change in-flight workflows.

baaf7ff6-14ee-49f4-9760-e9136f95cd68.name: current_state
baaf7ff6-14ee-49f4-9760-e9136f95cd68.comment: Current FSM state (e.g., 'OTP_REQUESTED', 'CONSENT_GRANTED'). Constrained by the FSM definition's allowed states.

bbca6845-701f-4248-ad9d-123374affb5c.name: context
bbca6845-701f-4248-ad9d-123374affb5c.comment: Workflow-instance variables (txnIds, tokens, intermediate IDs). Definition-driven.

b9c15c98-1802-40ee-b2dd-c8ab45254dca.name: external_correlation_id
b9c15c98-1802-40ee-b2dd-c8ab45254dca.comment: Identifier from the external system (e.g., ABDM gateway txnId or requestId). Indexed for inbound callback lookup.

24f89b1e-85c2-4fb8-80d0-e7b306f1afb1.name: patient_id
24f89b1e-85c2-4fb8-80d0-e7b306f1afb1.comment: EMPI patient_id when known. Linked at the moment the workflow associates with a patient.

924d6cc4-cbd1-4490-ad71-5eeed02a361a.name: error
924d6cc4-cbd1-4490-ad71-5eeed02a361a.comment: Last error message if status in ('failed','timed_out').

eb66d1a8-bcc8-4233-96d8-2dc249942204.name: id
eb66d1a8-bcc8-4233-96d8-2dc249942204.comment: Monotonic transition ID. Used for ordering.

f4f546e9-c837-48c7-b533-16b8826f72d7.name: from_state
f4f546e9-c837-48c7-b533-16b8826f72d7.comment: NULL for the initial transition into the start state.

5a7780de-2d1e-4e06-bc71-f58f6851cc89.name: trigger_payload
5a7780de-2d1e-4e06-bc71-f58f6851cc89.comment: Event payload or timer-fire metadata that caused the transition. Redacted of PHI per audit policy.

c52f6d82-5f4a-40ce-bd60-045a043569a5.name: actor
c52f6d82-5f4a-40ce-bd60-045a043569a5.comment: User UUID for 'manual' trigger; service account name otherwise.

7eaa2a25-970d-4cb7-a47c-cd2b56805d89.name: fire_at
7eaa2a25-970d-4cb7-a47c-cd2b56805d89.comment: Wall-clock time at which to fire.

33ff473a-0177-4007-8394-aaf266a297a5.name: transition_event
33ff473a-0177-4007-8394-aaf266a297a5.comment: Event name to dispatch (matched against FSM definition transitions).

68dd72d9-379e-4952-958b-a77f0670bcfb.name: external_message_id
68dd72d9-379e-4952-958b-a77f0670bcfb.comment: External system's message identifier (e.g., HL7v2 MSH-10, ABDM requestId). Used for idempotency.

a268cc69-7cd4-42f1-b190-62ee5100b4e8.name: endpoint
a268cc69-7cd4-42f1-b190-62ee5100b4e8.comment: Endpoint path that received the message (e.g., '/v3/hip/care-context/on-discover').

a14cefd9-27d6-4fca-b865-52da06f8cea6.name: headers
a14cefd9-27d6-4fca-b865-52da06f8cea6.comment: Selected headers preserved for audit. Redacted of bearer tokens / API keys.

2cb4d363-7aae-4116-b117-ab699a5e57d2.name: payload_storage_ref
2cb4d363-7aae-4116-b117-ab699a5e57d2.comment: Reference to where the raw payload is stored (DB column for small, object-storage URL for large). Cleartext payload retention per regulatory policy.

9e09c6b7-fff4-4b50-be00-ea4a7e465627.name: payload_hash
9e09c6b7-fff4-4b50-be00-ea4a7e465627.comment: SHA-256 of payload bytes for integrity verification.

f3725f08-e9cb-41d2-ab7e-a96da33343aa.name: workflow_id
f3725f08-e9cb-41d2-ab7e-a96da33343aa.comment: Resolved workflow this message belongs to (if any).

7ba966f0-0a2a-404c-9311-66c2f9190f01.name: idempotency_key
7ba966f0-0a2a-404c-9311-66c2f9190f01.comment: Set by callers to deduplicate retries originating from the platform side.

542d9d0a-645b-4849-ae9d-2be3bf948600.name: headers
542d9d0a-645b-4849-ae9d-2be3bf948600.comment: Selected headers preserved for audit. Tokens redacted.

39ed6b46-7d36-431d-a60b-6e7d37886509.name: next_retry_at
39ed6b46-7d36-431d-a60b-6e7d37886509.comment: Set when scheduled for retry; cleared on terminal outcome.

41008d4a635f4627b01bf9f9cdba9c57.value:
PHASE 0 — Generic control plane + FSM engine substrate.

7 tables. The substrate every adapter shares — integration registry,
credential references, durable workflow state, transitions log, timers,
inbound + outbound message logs. No ABDM yet.

Per ADR-0026 (FSM-lite): Phase 0 ships the four helper functions
(loadWorkflow, transitionTo, scheduleTimer, clearTimer) on top of these
tables. The generic FSM engine described in ADR-0027 is deferred to
Phase 1.5; the schema is identical in both phases.

Per ADR-0024: there is no integration_audit_log table. Audit substrate is
workflow_transitions + inbound/outbound messages + domain events + structured
request logs, projected by the centralized audit consumer.

Secrets: integration_credentials.vault_ref uses 'env:VAR_NAME' as the
Phase 0/1 default; real vault schemes (azure-keyvault://, aws-sm://, vault://)
are pre-prod gate.
